/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from zipfile import ZipFile
p=Path('/Users/wangye/Desktop/贴纸/outputs/月下温泉-分割三号-完整贴纸素材包.zip')
print('path:', p)
print('size_mb:', round(p.stat().st_size/1024/1024, 2))
with ZipFile(p) as z:
    names=[n for n in z.namelist() if not n.endswith('/')]
    print('file_count:',len(names))
    print('png_count:',sum(n.lower().endswith('.png') for n in names))
    print('metadata_files:')
    for n in names:
        if n.lower().endswith(('.json','.md','.txt','.csv')): print(n)
    print('first_15_files:')
    for n in names[:15]: print(n)
PY"
